environment: Loop Engine and software-change provider CLIs

in_scope: local repository artifacts and configured workers

outside_obligations.obligation: The provider remains deterministic and external reviewers retain semantic authority.

problem: A trusted operator needs one status decision for a started local job, but the draft treats every possible status label as a separate deliverable.
outcome: The public status view reports the result of the started local job.

acceptance.statement: The public status view reports that a started job is running.
The public status view reports that a started job succeeded.
The public status view reports that a started job failed.
The public status view reports that a started job is unknown when evidence is missing.

constraints: All status labels are observations of the same started-job status decision.
The view uses the existing local CLI and captured worker evidence.
non_goals: A new notification channel or distributed monitoring service.
